utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I believe the repair drive was set up in the shed behind Bo's house, but you might want to confirm if it's still there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks Opal, I'll head over to Bo's shed later today to make sure everything's in order. Appreciate the heads up!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem, Rosa. Let me know if you need a hand moving anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I've been picking up bits about that repair drive from others—what's the real scoop?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's going to be awesome! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM, and folks are bringing all sorts of broken stuff to fix up together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I might not have much to offer, but I'd love to come by and see what it's all about.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, I've been stockpiling some spare parts and tools for the repair drive—do you know if we're still on for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven't heard any changes, so I think we're still on. Mina might know more—she asked about my lawnmower earlier.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know it's still on. I've got some extra wrenches if Mina needs them for that lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! You know, I think I have some spare screws somewhere. Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait — are you talking about the same repair drive I'm gathering details on? Because I'm not sure what we're fixing yet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, uh, maybe not? I just remember something about fixing things... You probably know better than me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think the repair drive is still on for this weekend, but I haven't heard a confirmed time yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, Mara mentioned Saturday at the community center. I've got that old clock I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at the community center, got it. I can help with the sign-up sheet if you need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Uli, I'm still waiting to hear back from the repair drive folks. Once I know more, I'll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Gus. I'll be ready for Saturday whenever you get the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli. I'll keep you posted as soon as I hear back from them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, have you heard anything about when that repair drive is finally coming through?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — have you talked to Pia? She seemed worried about people overlapping on the same repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Pia's worried about overlap? That makes sense — I've been keeping my toolbox ready but no one's told me a solid date yet either.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got a few old hammers and wrenches set aside for Saturday morning pickup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's great, Eli! So you're bringing them to the community center next Saturday, right? That's what I heard—everyone's gathering there to fix things up together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, Vik, I heard they're picking them up from my place Saturday morning. I'm not much for big crowds anymore.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, are you also helping with the repair drive? I've already offered to lend some tools and a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! I signed up to help organize the donations. I heard Eli's pitching in some old hammers and wrenches too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Tess! Between Eli's tools and mine, we should have a solid collection. I'm meeting Gus tomorrow morning to sort through everything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly—if we don't coordinate, we'll have two neighbors trying to fix the same pothole while another one gets ignored.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: And you trust that group to actually coordinate things properly? I'd want to see a plan in writing first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I agree, a written plan would help. Maybe we should ask them for a schedule or map of who's fixing what.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I'm late. Did I miss anything on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam's bringing a cordless drill Saturday morning. We'll haul old wood then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Leo. I'll bring my hammer and a crowbar. Need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, this Saturday at the community center! Bring any broken items you'd like fixed, and I'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, this Saturday? Good to know, I'll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I hope you can! We'll have tools and spare parts for most things, so don't hesitate to bring whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Saturday morning works for me. I'll have those tools ready out on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I'll swing by Saturday morning then. Need me to bring anything specific, or you got it covered?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got it covered, Dane. Just make sure you're here before noon — I like to keep things on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Bo, have you heard anything about the repair drive times? I'm trying to get the sign-up sheet sorted before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's in the shed, but you might want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Okay, thanks Bo — I'll have a look at the shed later. Just wanted to make sure we weren't missing a set time for the event itself.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, Sam offered a cordless drill and Saturday morning. That work for you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, a cordless drill on Saturday morning sounds great. I'll bring my extension cords and we can set up a real repair station.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Saturday morning it is. I'll let Sam know we're on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, Rosa, I've got a cordless drill ready, and I'm free Saturday morning to help haul that wood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's fantastic, Sam! A cordless drill will be really handy. I'll add you to the Saturday morning crew—thanks for stepping up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, glad to be on the team. I'll swing by your place Saturday morning with my drill.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds interesting! What kind of repairs are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some fences and garden gates in the neighborhood that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, fences and gates — are they mostly wood or metal? I want to make sure we have the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Tess, perfect timing! We're discussing the repair drive—Cleo was just asking what supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I've got a list here—mainly spare parts and tools that are still usable.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Cleo! I'll add your name to the volunteer list too—we can always use more hands for fixing things up!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We should set up a shared calendar or a simple sign-up sheet to avoid conflicts. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds smart, but who's going to keep it updated? I don't want it to turn into another thing we forget about.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How about we just do a quick text chain? I can start it, and we all just reply with our planned times.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, you heard anything solid about when that repair drive might finally roll through? I keep getting mixed signals.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the one organized by that new group? Are you sure it's legit?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's the one. I'm not sure either—heard it from a few folks but nothing official.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, just so you know, we're having that repair drive next Saturday at the community center — everyone's bringing their busted tools to fix up together!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, next Saturday works for me! I'll reach out to those book club folks who are handy with electronics and see who can make it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll spread the word to the gardening group too—the more the merrier!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, today! Thanks, Cleo. I'll go dig through my shed for any spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Oren! They're meeting at the old community center — I'll be there first thing this morning!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The community center? Right, right... I'll try to remember to head over there. What time did you say again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Saturday from 10 to 4. I'll have my tools ready for that clock!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like you're all set for Saturday; I'll make sure to stop by and see how that clock repair goes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll look forward to seeing you there! Should be a fun Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm pretty sure I saw the repair drive setup near the old oak tree by the park, but let me know if you spot it somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't been by the park yet, but I'll keep an eye out. Thanks for the tip, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You're welcome, Nell. I'll be checking by the Johnson's fence later—heard a rumor it might've shifted over there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
